title: Module manifest
description: A module artifact's module.json. It does not list steps: describe is the one source of truth about what the module does.

name.description: The module's name, a plain directory name that prefixes its steps and event kinds.

version.description: The module's version, independent of Coanda's.

moduleApiVersion.description: The module API version the module speaks. This schema is version 1.

start.description: The command that starts the module: the program, relative to the artifact directory, then each argument, each passed as one argument with no shell between.

sourceUrl.description: Where the module's source can be read.

sourceCommit.description: The commit of the source the artifact was built from.
